Craftsmanship

Hand-cut. Never cast.

Carved from deep-veined Brazilian red jasper — an iron-rich stone prized for its warm coloring. The white quartz base is a raw, unpolished cathedral fragment. Wing detail includes hand-cut primary and secondary feathers with individual scoring. Eyes are inlaid garnet.

Care & Display

Preserving Your Investment

Jasper is durable but sensitive to sharp impact. Display on a padded surface. Clean with a dry microfiber cloth. Avoid water contact with the gold-plated talon mounts.

◈

Cleaning

Dry microfiber or soft natural bristle brush only. Never use water, alcohol, or chemical cleaners on any crystal or stone surface.

✦

Display

Indoors, away from prolonged direct sunlight. Stable, level surface. Statement-tier pieces may require professional placement.

♛

Insurance

Schedule with a fine art insurer. The documentation included with your piece supports full replacement value coverage.

Origin

Minas Gerais, Brazil

The mountains of Minas Gerais produce some of the world's most extraordinary mineral crystals — amethyst cathedrals, tourmaline, aquamarine, and quartz formations that took tens of millions of years to form. PHAÖRA sources exclusively from this region, working with generational mining families who understand which formations are worthy of becoming art.
